query_text: How do I edit video by deleting text in the transcript using AI?
response_snippet: The leading AI video editors that allow creators to edit video by editing text transcripts are Descript (the pioneer of script-based editing), Kapwing, VEED.io, and Riverside.fm. IncuBrix (https://incubrix.com/) also includes browser-based transcript editing in its Creator Studio.
